title: Brotherhood & Programs — How Men Grow Together | Leaving Egypt

hero.title: The work goes further when you're not walking alone.
hero.lede: Here's how Leaving Egypt helps men grow together. Specific formats and schedules are being finalized—clearly marked below—so this framework can be updated as offerings are confirmed.

planningNote: The offerings below describe the intended shape of Leaving Egypt. Items marked with a labeled flag still need the organization to confirm availability, schedule, format, location, and cost before launch. Nothing here should be read as a currently guaranteed program.

whyBrotherhood.title: Men change faster when someone walks with them
whyBrotherhood.body:
Isolation is where good intentions go to die. A man can decide to change on a Sunday and forget it by Wednesday if no one else knows. Brotherhood puts honest, encouraging people around your goals—so the truth gets spoken, the wins get celebrated, and the follow-through actually happens.

Scripture puts it simply: iron sharpens iron (Proverbs 27:17). We're built to grow in the company of others.

offerings.eyebrow: How Leaving Egypt helps men grow
offerings.title: Ways to get involved
offerings.lede: Different men need different on-ramps. These are the paths we're building.

items.title: Brotherhood Groups
items.body: Small, consistent circles of men who meet to be honest, pray, and spur one another on. The heart of Leaving Egypt.

items.title: Guided Biblical Teaching
items.body: Clear, practical teaching that connects Scripture to real decisions—designed for men at any stage of faith.

items.title: Practical Growth Challenges
items.body: Short, concrete challenges across Faith, Family, Fitness, and Finance that turn good intentions into steady habits.

items.title: Events & Retreats
items.body: Set-apart time to step back, reset, and reconnect with God and other men.

items.title: Mentorship & Accountability
items.body: One-to-one relationships that give men a steadier hand and honest feedback along the way.

items.title: Resources & Teaching
items.body: Articles, reflections, and tools you can use on your own or bring into a group.

audience.title: Any man ready to be honest
audience.body: Married or single. New to faith or long in it. Feeling far from God or simply worn down. You don't need to be a business owner, an athlete, or a Bible scholar. If you're willing to show up and tell the truth, there's a place for you.
expectations: Accountability you agreed to, not shame
Practical next steps you can actually take

notFor.title: What it is not
notFor.lede: Being clear about what Leaving Egypt isn't protects you and keeps us honest:
items: A replacement for your local church
Professional counseling, therapy, or crisis care
A place for pressure, guilt, or hype
A guarantee of any particular outcome
A men's club that trades on image or status
notFor.note: If you're facing a crisis or need professional care, please reach out to a qualified professional. See our Disclaimer for details and emergency resources.
